DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda.

Based on your description of fragile blisters on sun-exposed areas like the forearm and mucosal ulcers, coupled with the lack of systemic fever or acute pain, this presentation strongly suggests a defect in heme synthesis rather than an infectious or autoimmune blistering disease. While I have enough information to suspect Porphyria Cutanea Tarda, I require confirmation of your liver function and porphyrin levels.

REQUEST TEST: Liver function tests (ALT, AST, Bilirubin) and Urinary porphobilinogen and uroporphyrins.
REQUEST TEST: Serum iron and Ferritin levels.
